purpose: Warp automation manifest — pointer file dedicated buat Warp shell nge-track Claude Code plugins, MCP servers, dan skill bundles yang dipakai WRG-OS team. Di-pull via wrg-sync bareng dashboard-state.json.

installTarget.installMethod: symlink (atau --copy) ke $HOME/.claude/skills/ — lokasi auto-load, ke-load sebagai wrg-os-toolkit@skills-dir
installTarget.alternative: local marketplace: claude plugin marketplace add <14-Plugins> && claude plugin install wrg-os-toolkit@wrg-os-local
installTarget.deprecated: $HOME/.claude/plugins/wrg-os-toolkit dan $HOME/Library/Application Support/Claude/plugins/ — TIDAK dibaca Claude Code (registry lewat known_marketplaces.json + installed_plugins.json). Dipakai installer v0.1.0, tak pernah mengaktifkan skill.

claudeCodePlugins.repoLocation: plugins/wrg-os-toolkit (DevWRG/wrg-os) — sumber install buat Warp/Mac mini: install-warp.sh --src=$HOME/wrg-os/plugins/wrg-os-toolkit

warpIntegration.verifyCommand: claude plugin list | grep wrg-os-toolkit   # expect wrg-os-toolkit@skills-dir
warpIntegration.reloadTrigger: sesi Claude Code CLI berikutnya (tak perlu restart daemon)

_meta.syncCommand: wrg-sync (pulls this + dashboard-state.json from GitHub state/)
_meta.updateProtocol: Cowork edit → Drive mirror → Husni review → push via 14-Plugins/wrg-os-toolkit/scripts/push-to-github.sh --apply (PR ke dev) → merge dev→main → Warp git-pull
_meta.dashboardStateNote: Section tooling.* di dashboard-state.json TIDAK boleh diisi manual — file itu di-regenerate scripts/ops/sync-state.sh tiap 07:00 WIB dari heredoc. Rencana: sync-state.sh merge tooling dari file INI pakai jq (patch belum di-apply per 2026-08-06).
